latestVersion.changelog:
ai-tool-research v1.0.0 — initial release

- Provides monthly research updates and productivity playbooks for Claude Desktop, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Google Gemini, and OpenClaw.
- Generates two Markdown files per tool: a Productivity Playbook (use cases, personas, examples, links) and a Skills Catalog (rated list of skills/extensions/plugins, mapped to personas).
- Uses a consistent, rated, month-over-month format with file date stamps and explicit "what's new" sections.
- Includes a checklist-driven workflow: confirms inputs, checks existing files, researches updates, rates new items, composes updates, and logs runs.
- Honors the open SKILL.md standard; works across common AI tool runtimes.
